column1: # Package classification for tv.py. Columns: package or wildcard pattern, group, note (tab separated).
# An exact name wins; among wildcards a core pattern wins, then the longest.
#   core        never touched; the TV needs it
#   home        a stock home screen; turned off only by `tv.py home stock --disable` after the new home is verified
#   home-guard  setup apps that can reopen setup once the stock home is off; turned off with it, only after setup is complete
#   ads         ads, tracking, telemetry; in the default plan
#   bloat       preinstalled apps and services most people never use; ask
#   optional    features some people rely on; ask
#   vendor      brand or chip services; review with the user, leave alone when unsure
# Anything unlisted is "system" (left alone) or "user" (installed by the owner).
